proof:
Source: Simon Ch. 6, §1 (chapter-06.txt, "Preliminaries: Vectors, Co-vectors, and Forms"): 1.1 (ω₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ ω_k(v₁, …, v_k) = Σ_σ sgn σ ω_{σ(1)}(v₁)⋯ω_{σ(k)}(v_k) = det(ω_i(v_j))), 1.2 (every k-covector is Σ_α ω_α dx^α over increasing multi-indices α, with ω_α = ω(e_α)) and 1.5 (the dx^α, α increasing, are orthonormal, so the Euclidean norm of Σ_α ω_α dx^α is (Σ_α ω_α²)^{1/2}; this is SimonGMT's covectorEuclideanNorm). The parent proof uses them in step 4 (the test forms Σ_l (−1)^l g_l dx^{ι(0)} ∧ ⋯ (dx^{ι(l)} omitted) ⋯ ∧ dx^{ι(m)}) and in step 3 (an n-covector α with α(e_ι) = 1 to read off the orientation sign). Notation: e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1, e_I := (e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(k−1)}), v_j the j-th coordinate of v ∈ ℝ^P, [A] := 1 if A holds and 0 otherwise.

1. Construction. For J : Fin k → Fin P let f_J be the continuous multilinear map (ℝ^P)^k → ℝ, f_J(v) := ∏_{r<k} (v_r)_{J(r)}; in Lean f_J := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra ℝ (Fin k) ℝ).compContinuousLinearMap (fun r => EuclideanSpace.proj (J r)). Put dx^J := ContinuousMultilinearMap.alternatization f_J, a continuous alternating map, i.e. an element of Covector (Euclid P) k (no finite-dimensionality argument is needed for continuity). By ContinuousMultilinearMap.alternatization_apply_apply, for every v : Fin k → ℝ^P,
  dx^J(v) = Σ_{σ ∈ Equiv.Perm (Fin k)} sign(σ) • ∏_{r<k} (v_{σ(r)})_{J(r)}
(sign(σ) ∈ {±1} acting on ℝ by multiplication; this is the Leibniz expansion of det[(v_c)_{J(r)}]_{r,c}). For k = 0 the only permutation is the identity and the empty product is 1, so dx^J(v) = 1.

2. Duality (i). Let I, J : Fin k → Fin P be strictly increasing and v := e_I. Since (e_i)_j = [i = j] (PiLp.single_apply; EuclideanSpace.single_apply is its deprecated alias), the σ-term ∏_r (e_{I(σ(r))})_{J(r)} equals 1 if I(σ(r)) = J(r) for every r, i.e. I ∘ σ = J, and 0 otherwise. Suppose I ∘ σ = J. As I is strictly increasing, I(a) < I(b) ⟺ a < b (StrictMono.lt_iff_lt); so for r < r', I(σ(r)) = J(r) < J(r') = I(σ(r')) gives σ(r) < σ(r'): σ is a strictly increasing map Fin k → Fin k. Its range is all of Fin k (σ is a bijection), which is also the range of id; two strictly increasing maps on Fin k with the same range coincide (StrictMono.range_inj_of_wellFoundedLT), so σ = id and hence J = I. Consequently, if I ≠ J every σ-term vanishes and dx^J(e_I) = 0; if I = J, the only nonzero term is σ = id (every σ with I ∘ σ = I is the identity, by the same argument), so dx^J(e_I) = sign(id)·1 = 1. This proves (i).

3. Values of combinations. Let N ∈ ℕ, J : Fin N → (Fin k → Fin P) injective with every J_l strictly increasing, c : Fin N → ℝ and α := Σ_{l<N} c_l·dx^{J_l}. For every strictly increasing I : Fin k → Fin P, (i) gives α(e_I) = Σ_l c_l·[I = J_l]. By injectivity of J at most one l satisfies J_l = I, so α(e_I) = c_l if I = J_l, and α(e_I) = 0 if I ∉ range J; in both cases α(e_I)² = Σ_l c_l²·[I = J_l].

4. The norm (ii). By definition covectorEuclideanNorm(α) is the square root of Σ_{I : Fin k → Fin P} (if I is strictly increasing then α(b∘I)² else 0), where b = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ satisfies b_i = e_i (EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply), so α(b∘I) = α(e_I). By step 3 this sum equals Σ_I [I strictly increasing]·Σ_l c_l²[I = J_l] = Σ_l c_l²·Σ_I [I strictly increasing ∧ I = J_l] = Σ_l c_l² (exchange the two finite sums, Finset.sum_comm; for each l exactly one I, namely J_l, is counted, because J_l is strictly increasing). Hence covectorEuclideanNorm(Σ_l c_l·dx^{J_l}) = (Σ_l c_l²)^{1/2} = Real.sqrt (Σ_l c_l²). (If k > P there are no strictly increasing maps, so (i) is vacuous and (ii) only concerns N = 0, where both sides are 0.) ∎

Appendix (Lean). The following tactic proof of exactly this frozen type was compiled during the decomposition with `lake env lean` against `import GMT.Ch07.Submission` in the comparator scope (stated as a `theorem ... := by` with this body); it uses only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound (deprecation warnings only):
```lean
  intro P k
  classical
  let dx : (Fin k → Fin P) → Covector (Euclid P) k := fun J =>
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.alternatization
      ((ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra ℝ (Fin k) ℝ).compContinuousLinearMap
        (fun r => EuclideanSpace.proj (J r)))
  have hdx : ∀ (J : Fin k → Fin P) (v : Fin k → Euclid P),
      dx J v = ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), Equiv.Perm.sign σ • ∏ r, (v (σ r)) (J r) := by
    intro J v
    simp only [dx, ContinuousMultilinearMap.alternatization_apply_apply,
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap_apply,
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply, Function.comp_apply]
    rfl
  -- a strictly increasing permutation is the identity
  have hperm : ∀ (I J : Fin k → Fin P), StrictMono I → StrictMono J →
      ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), (∀ r, I (σ r) = J r) → σ = 1 ∧ I = J := by
    intro I J hI hJ σ hσ
    have hσmono : StrictMono σ := by
      intro a b hab
      have : I (σ a) < I (σ b) := by rw [hσ a, hσ b]; exact hJ hab
      exact hI.lt_iff_lt.mp this
    have hrange : Set.range σ = Set.range (id : Fin k → Fin k) := by
      rw [Set.range_id]; exact σ.surjective.range_eq
    have hid : (σ : Fin k → Fin k) = id :=
      (StrictMono.range_inj_of_wellFoundedLT hσmono strictMono_id).mp hrange
    have hσ1 : σ = 1 := by
      ext r; simp [congrFun hid r]
    refine ⟨hσ1, ?_⟩
    funext r
    have := hσ r
    rw [hσ1] at this
    simpa using this
  have hdual : ∀ I J : Fin k → Fin P, StrictMono I → StrictMono J →
      dx J (fun r => EuclideanSpace.single (I r) (1 : ℝ)) = if I = J then 1 else 0 := by
    intro I J hI hJ
    rw [hdx]
    have hterm : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k),
        ∏ r, (EuclideanSpace.single (I (σ r)) (1 : ℝ)) (J r) =
          if (∀ r, I (σ r) = J r) then 1 else 0 := by
      intro σ
      split_ifs with h
      · refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun r _ => ?_
        rw [h r]; simp
      · push_neg at h
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
        refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ r) ?_
        simp [PiLp.single_apply, Ne.symm hr]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    split_ifs with hIJ
    · subst hIJ
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin k))]
      · simp
      · intro σ _ hσ
        rw [if_neg]
        · simp
        · intro h
          exact hσ (hperm I I hI hI σ h).1
      · simp
    · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun σ _ => ?_
      rw [if_neg]
      · simp
      · intro h
        exact hIJ (hperm I J hI hJ σ h).2
  refine ⟨dx, hdual, ?_⟩
  intro N J c hJinj hJmono
  -- values on coordinate frames
  have hval : ∀ I : Fin k → Fin P, StrictMono I →
      (∑ l, c l • dx (J l)) (fun r => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (I r)) =
        ∑ l, if I = J l then c l else 0 := by
    intro I hI
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    rw [ContinuousAlternatingMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rw [ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, hdual I (J l) hI (hJmono l)]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hsq : ∀ I : Fin k → Fin P,
      (∑ l, if I = J l then c l else 0) ^ 2 = ∑ l, if I = J l then c l ^ 2 else 0 := by
    intro I
    by_cases hex : ∃ l, I = J l
    · obtain ⟨l₀, hl₀⟩ := hex
      have h1 : (∑ l, if I = J l then c l else 0) = c l₀ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single l₀]
        · simp [hl₀]
        · intro l _ hl
          rw [if_neg]
          intro h
          exact hl (hJinj (h.symm.trans hl₀))
        · simp
      have h2 : (∑ l, if I = J l then c l ^ 2 else 0) = c l₀ ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single l₀]
        · simp [hl₀]
        · intro l _ hl
          rw [if_neg]
          intro h
          exact hl (hJinj (h.symm.trans hl₀))
        · simp
      rw [h1, h2]
    · push_neg at hex
      simp [hex]
  unfold covectorEuclideanNorm
  congr 1
  calc (∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, if StrictMono I then
          ((∑ l, c l • dx (J l)) (fun i => EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ (I i))) ^ 2 else 0)
      = ∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, ∑ l, (if I = J l then c l ^ 2 else 0) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun I _ => ?_
        split_ifs with hI
        · rw [hval I hI, hsq I]
        · symm
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => ?_
          rw [if_neg]
          rintro rfl
          exact hI (hJmono l)
    _ = ∑ l, ∑ I : Fin k → Fin P, (if I = J l then c l ^ 2 else 0) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ l, c l ^ 2 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
        simp
```
key_steps: dx^J := alternatization of the continuous multilinear map v ↦ ∏_r (v_r)_{J(r)} (mkPiAlgebra composed with the coordinate projections), so dx^J(v) = Σ_σ sign σ ∏_r (v_{σ r})_{J r}.
For strictly increasing I, J the σ-term at v = e_I is [I ∘ σ = J]; I ∘ σ = J forces σ strictly increasing, hence σ = id and I = J, so dx^J(e_I) = [I = J].
For an injective family of strictly increasing J_l, (Σ_l c_l dx^{J_l})(e_I) = c_l if I = J_l and 0 if I ∉ range J.
Summing the squares over strictly increasing I (basisFun = single) gives Σ_l c_l², hence covectorEuclideanNorm = sqrt(Σ_l c_l²).
